title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-11-07
lineage: aud 1st gen 7" reel @ 3.75 ips, dolby b Jerry Moore's copy;  technics rs-1506>sony nr-335>hd-p2 24/48> cd wave>adobe 2.0 16/44>flac
source: mastered on uher reel w/akg d190e mics taped by Marty Weinberg

ai_review.summary: Fair audience recording capturing a ragged late‑show third set with solid crowd energy despite noticeable cuts.
ai_review.review: The tape is an audience recording from the era, featuring many cuts and fluctuating levels that give it a ragged character. The performance carries good crowd energy and the raw vibe of a 1970 late show, though no specific standout moments are highlighted. It’s a decent listen for fans who appreciate the period sound despite its technical imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Based on a single 3‑star review that notes both positive crowd energy and negative recording issues, leading to an average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape with many cuts and fluctuating sound levels; ragged but acceptable for the era.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Third set of a late show with good crowd energy and characteristic 1970 raw sound.
